caption: Supplementary Figure S4 | Cross-country transfer and monitoring-network sensitivity. (A) R² for all 17 held-out countries under strict-QA no-meteorology HGB and Ridge full models, shown on a signed-log scale. (B,C) United States and Canadian 2022 RMSE under nested station thinning, separated by meteorological profile. Marker shape identifies the three fixed seeds; open diamonds show full-network endpoints. Points represent observed sample sizes, and seed differences are descriptive. LOCO denotes leave-one-country-out validation; HGB denotes histogram-based gradient boosting, and MET meteorological predictors.
